slides.title: Every complaint hides a *request*
slides.sub: Listen for the ask inside it.

slides.title: Hear the sting first
slides.body: "You never call." "You're always on your phone." It lands like an attack, and the urge is to defend yourself.

slides.title: Look for the ask
slides.body: Under most complaints is a request that didn't come out plainly. "You never call" can mean "I miss you."

slides.title: Ask, don't guess
slides.body: Before you defend, try: "What would you like from me here?" Then listen to the answer.

slides.title: Try it once this week
slides.body: Next time someone's upset with you, write down their complaint. Next to it, write the request you hear inside it.
